laws.statement: Resource truth is relative to a declared actor/system boundary and exact Reality aspect; coarse Resource is an existential projection over at least one supported admissible transition witness.
laws.deleteConsequence: Hostile/irrelevant aspects, ticker/asset identity, exact reviewed bytes and security target identities can be conflated; capability labels become self-authenticating.
laws.reopen: Reopen only if a materially different owner can make correct Resource decisions without actor boundary, aspect identity or any transition witness.

laws.statement: Events, Claims, authority, access, quantities and domain state remain owner-native; World may join/project them but does not become their second source authority.
laws.deleteConsequence: Historical/current truth is rewritten by a World state machine and cross-owner projections become accidental authority.
laws.reopen: Reopen only if multiple owners demonstrably cannot reconcile required shared truth and one lower owner can own it without duplicating native authority.

laws.statement: Evidence is a provenance/method/time-bound support, contradiction, bounding or unresolved relation to an explicit Claim; Resource-level provenance alone does not establish transition/capability truth.
laws.deleteConsequence: Missing/stale evidence becomes false truth, negative evidence disappears, and aggregator/candidate capability labels can mint current ResourceFor truth.
laws.reopen: Reopen only if a simpler representation prevents R9P01 and all five dogfood overclaims without an explicit claim-support boundary.

laws.statement: Historical Events/accepted Claims remain historical truth while current applicability/actionability is recomputed as-of from claim-specific clocks; there is no universal Resource current/lifecycle bit.
laws.deleteConsequence: Later evidence leaks backward, revoked/stale facts erase history, and one lifecycle state cannot express simultaneous demand-specific projections.
laws.reopen: Reopen only if a universal state machine survives concurrent demands, independently stale claims and non-monotonic access without loss.

laws.statement: Resource may exist before possessed authority/access/current demand fit; ActionableResourceFor is the demand/time projection where required current conditions hold, and Option is the selectable feasible relation.
laws.deleteConsequence: Gated/deferred/reference resources disappear or Resource collapses into current permission/use.
laws.reopen: Reopen only if deferred acquisition, dormant/reference resources and workload-specific actionability can be represented with fewer distinctions without changing decisions.

laws.statement: Target transitions have explicit Requirements, contextual Assignments and native Constraints; feasible composition is a projection, not a global dependency graph.
laws.deleteConsequence: Partial resources are treated as jointly sufficient or owner-local admission/reducers are duplicated by a global graph.
laws.reopen: Reopen a shared engine only after multiple materially different consumers reproduce the same missing composition executor above owner boundaries.

laws.statement: Capacity/rate/budget/stock/flow are native-unit, native-clock constraints used when they change feasibility, throughput, risk, contention, burden or recovery; no global scalar Capacity exists.
laws.deleteConsequence: Minimum notional, slots, concurrency and review burden cease to affect feasibility; a global scalar launders incompatible units.
laws.reopen: Reopen a shared Capacity surface only when one concrete cross-owner query repeatedly needs the same quantity semantics and current owners cannot answer it by projection.

laws.statement: Substitution derives from alternative feasible assignments for the same requirement/context; redundancy additionally requires sufficient independence against a declared disturbance and requested load.
laws.deleteConsequence: Duplicate keys/endpoints/providers are miscounted as capacity or resilience and common-mode failure is hidden.
laws.reopen: Reopen intrinsic substitute/redundancy edges only if they remain invariant across purpose, transition, load, time and disturbance.

laws.law: Action, Effect, Outcome, Attribution, Knowledge remain separate
laws.statement: Action records an admitted attempt; Effect is owner-native consequence; Outcome is domain-owned evaluation; Attribution is a separate causal claim; Knowledge is an explicit reusable promotion.
laws.deleteConsequence: Process success becomes domain success, observed outcomes get false causal credit, and every receipt/review/failure becomes promoted knowledge.
laws.reopen: Reopen only if a collapsed representation preserves exogenous effects, nested outcomes, uncertainty, counterfactual attribution and learning from failed/invalid episodes.

laws.statement: Transport, target applicability, independence, coverage, reversibility/consequence and value-of-information are downstream questions of a particular Claim and decision; collect direct target evidence only when residual uncertainty can change action.
laws.deleteConsequence: Measurement availability becomes an admission reason, weak external evidence is overgeneralized, or every claim requires expensive local replication.
laws.reopen: Reopen a universal Transfer Contract only if multiple owners repeatedly need the same persisted transport object and local projection cannot recover the decision.

laws.statement: A shared production seam is earned only when repeated semantics coincide with repeated missing executable responsibility, owner-local resolution fails, and moving responsibility downward reduces total system complexity.
laws.deleteConsequence: Repeated vocabulary automatically grows registries/services and creates duplicate authority.
laws.reopen: This is itself the reopen test for any rejected global surface.

claimProvenanceFixTournament.name: OwnerVerification.verified_capabilities
claimProvenanceFixTournament.shape: Add a tuple of owner-attested capability labels to the existing current OwnerVerification. Candidate.capabilities remains discovery/ranking vocabulary. Required capability present only in candidate but absent from current verified_capabilities yields owner-verification-required, not not-fit and not consumable-now.
claimProvenanceFixTournament.authority: PASS: owner-native current verification remains the claim source
claimProvenanceFixTournament.compatibility: HIGH: direct constructor use is local to one test module; field can default empty but tests/fixtures must explicitly attest capabilities
claimProvenanceFixTournament.future: MEDIUM/HIGH: later non-owner semantic evidence can still motivate a narrower general claim-support object if a real consumer appears
claimProvenanceFixTournament.risk: Does not represent every possible multi-source capability proof; deliberately narrow to current generic discovery pipeline.

claimProvenanceFixTournament.name: CapabilityEvidence object
claimProvenanceFixTournament.shape: Create a new claim/evidence dataclass passed to evaluate_resource, with resource_id/capability/source/time/evidence refs.
claimProvenanceFixTournament.risk: Over-generalizes R9P01 into a new evidence object before a second executable consumer needs it; starts rebuilding R8 research ontology in production.

claimProvenanceFixTournament.name: Capability proof inside DiscoveryEvidence/ResourceCandidate
claimProvenanceFixTournament.shape: Annotate discovery provenance/candidate capabilities with proof refs and let evaluator infer verified capability from candidate provenance.
claimProvenanceFixTournament.authority: FAIL: discovery/aggregator plane can become semantic truth owner
claimProvenanceFixTournament.risk: Reintroduces the exact R3/R8 provenance laundering that R9P01 falsified.

winner.reason: Only A fixes the reproduced current evaluator bug while adding no new production object/service and preserving owner-native authority. It deliberately solves only the current owner-attested generic discovery path; broader claim-support machinery remains unearned.
